component.name: Halo
component.summary: Lighting and keys for gaming gear

description.p: Halo sets lighting, key and button assignments, actuation and DPI on supported gaming keyboards and mice, and fan curves, lighting and screens on hubs and coolers. It draws each device and lights it the way the device itself is lit.
Halo uses the OpenLinkHub service to talk to devices and includes a copy of it. OpenLinkHub is free software under the GPL-3.0 license.
The first time it runs, Halo shows one command to copy into a terminal. It grants access to your devices and is needed once.

Halo is an independent project. It is not made by, affiliated with or endorsed by any device maker. It is used daily with a K70 MAX keyboard and a Scimitar Elite Wireless mouse; other devices are supported through OpenLinkHub but have not been tested on real hardware.
